title: 🔆🔅Iranian father speaks after US airstrike hits his daughter's wedding.
text:
🔆🔅Iranian father speaks after US airstrike hits his daughter's wedding."

" This footage features Ali Mallahi, the father of the bride, as he provides his firsthand account of the US airstrike that targeted his home in the Sirik district (Kuhestak region) of Hormozgan Province."

" Mr. Mallahi was hosting his daughter's wedding celebration when the attack occurred, instantly transforming a night of joy into one of mourning. The airstrike resulted in the deaths of at least four people. Among the victims were a four-year-old child, Amirali Karimi, and a 16-year-old, Mohammad Mallahi. In total, 68 people were also injured in the attack."

"Mr. Mallahi describes the events of that night and the moment the attack took place."

"- Ali Mallahi, Homeowner: “This area and this house is residential and unfortunately the incident happened at the wedding of my daughter, and was hit by two drones""

"- Ali Mallahi, Homeowner: "It was an unpleasant event! until now, I have been very, very worried and upset about this matter, and really, I don't know what can I say... only that thank God the casualties weren't greater than this.
